packTitle: Marlowe & Finch: Law Firm Theme (6 Pages)
description: A complete six-page Divi 5 website for a law firm, solicitors, notary, accountancy or any serious professional practice, ready to make your own. Home, Practice Areas, Our Approach, The Partners, Client Guides and Contact share one measured, formal identity: cool grey backgrounds, a deep oxblood accent, Spectral serif headings and double-rule buttons. Every section is built from proven, validated recipes and a single design language and style kit, so buttons, accordions, forms and type match on every page, on desktop, tablet and phone. A type-led editorial hero, a figures band, practice-area blurbs, a client quote, fee options, a first-meeting checklist, a four-step method, a month-by-month matter timeline, partner profiles with a founder note, directory quotes and client guides are all in place. Names, fees and reviews are sample copy: swap in your own and publish. No lorem ipsum, no broken layouts. One simple commercial license, unlimited client sites.
